project_intent.name: Service Request Portal
project_intent.summary: Create one governed portal for customers to submit and track service requests.
project_intent.problem: Requests arrive through disconnected email threads and cannot be measured.
project_intent.opportunity: Give customers and service teams a shared, traceable workflow.

business_outcomes.description: Reduce the time needed to acknowledge a new request.

capabilities.name: Request intake
capabilities.description: Capture and classify a customer service request.

core_processes.name: Triage request
core_processes.description: Validate, classify, and assign a submitted request.
core_processes.trigger: A customer submits a complete request.

business_rules.description: Only an authenticated customer may view their request details.

data_entities.name: Service Request
data_entities.description: The governed record of a customer's requested service.

integrations.name: Identity Provider
security_rules: Use authorization code flow with PKCE

quality_requirements.description: Interactive portal requests must respond quickly under normal load.
acceptance_criteria: 95th percentile API latency is below 500 ms

constraints.description: The first release must run in Docker on a single managed environment.
